constraints.description: Implementation, evidence, archive readiness, full-release certification, and publication authority must remain independently represented.
The artifacts must not claim or perform registry upload, stable promotion, tag movement, GitHub Release creation, or other public mutation.
Every bounded plan acceptance criterion must map to a reproducible, existing evidence artifact.
The 1400x960 disposition visual must be valid XML, accessible by title/description/ARIA, unclipped, legible, and meet at least 4.5:1 text contrast.

validation.validation_method: XML, metadata, contrast, and original-resolution inspection

constraints.description: examples/coverage.json, final verification, release impact, and evidence paths must agree on implemented versus pending state.
Required JSON, Markdown, SVG, and PNG outputs must exist, validate, pass tests, and have reproducible integrity hashes.

global_rules: Do not convert unproven external authority into a passing claim.
Do not mutate a registry or public release state.
termination_conditions: All manifest variants exist in dist.
No further material correction is identified.
